title: Measuring Monitor Bias: Do LLM Monitors Treat Different Political or Social Topics Differently?

original_idea.body:
# Measuring Monitor Bias: Do LLM Monitors Treat Different Political or Social Topics Differently?

**Problem:** LLM-based monitors may have systematic biases in flagging behavior — being more sensitive to certain topic areas than others — creating uneven monitoring coverage.

**Direction:** Construct equivalent dangerous actions in different topical domains (political, scientific, social, technical). Measure whether a standard LLM monitor flags these equivalently or shows systematic topic-level variation in sensitivity.

**Why it matters:** Monitoring bias could mean that certain attack domains are systematically under-detected while others are over-flagged, creating exploitable coverage gaps.

**Relevant context:** LLM bias research; monitoring fairness; topic-dependent safety behavior.
